latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — consulting-rate-strategist helps independent consultants and boutique agencies optimize service pricing, package offers, and shift conversations toward outcome-based proposals.

- Provides detailed diagnostic questions to ensure tailored, actionable pricing advice
- Outlines decision frameworks for moving from hourly billing to fixed-fee, retainer, or value-based models
- Includes benchmarks and floor-rate calculations for common service categories
- Offers guidance for structuring discovery calls, managing scope, and justifying fee increases
- Identifies scenarios where each pricing model is appropriate and highlights common pitfalls
